printed_to_pdf_page_rule: PDF page floor((printed page + 6) / 2); even printed page left, odd right.
row_scope: 80 explicit nonstop rows in selected northeast tables: 47 Ransome and 33 Delta. Connecting/through rows excluded; each independently timed segment retains its own weekdays.
operator_identification: Printed p.4: 1750–1874 Ransome Airlines. Selected mainline flight numbers are below Delta Connection ranges.
frequency_legend: D encodes blank/daily; X excludes weekdays, 1 Monday through 7 Sunday. Star denotes off-peak fare, not date rollover.

special_cases.Airport suffixes: New York J=JFK, L=LGA, E=EWR; Washington N=National/DCA, I=Baltimore/BWI. JFK–DCA 1803 departs 12:45J, not LaGuardia. Original suffixes retained and checked.
special_cases.Through rows: DCA–PHL 1814 has one stop at Trenton. Separate legs DCA–TTN 08:10–09:00 and TTN–PHL 09:15–09:40; PHL–DCA 10:00–10:45 completes the source-timed sequence. Other through itineraries do not create extra nonstop movements.
special_cases.Weekdays: DCA–PHL 1802 excludes Saturday and Sunday, while PHL–JFK 1802 excludes Sunday only. PWM–BOS 1787 excludes Sunday, but the onward BOS–HYA–LGA legs exclude both Saturday and Sunday. Each leg retains its own days.
special_cases.Outside window: Sunday-only DCA–PHL 1759, PHL–ISP 1759 and PHL–DCA 1762 remain reviewed schedules with no movements.
special_cases.Aircraft: No individual aircraft type or registration assigned from generic equipment legends.
special_cases.Airport locations: HYA and TTN historical airport names/codes follow pp.260–261. Approximate current FAA reference points are markers, not reconstructed 1986 positions.
